Details: Synthetic 90-day dataset for a C30 demand-forecasting and inventory / raw-material procurement prototype.
2026-07-20 through 2026-10-17 inclusive (90 days). Forecast horizon: 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-24.
Four illustrative locations: two cafés (CAFE01/CAFE02) and two grocery shops (GROC01/GROC02). Names are invented.
Five café prepared-food items per café and five grocery SKUs per grocery shop.
All store names, footfall, sales, stock movements, ingredient usage, batch records and purchase orders in this workbook are synthetic. They are NOT actual business records.

Estimated_Demand_Units is latent simulated customer demand. Units_Sold is capped by eligible stock. Lost_Demand_Units = demand minus sales, to represent potential lost sales. Real stores generally need to estimate lost demand during stockouts.
Footfall_Visits is illustrative customer visits per location per day. Transactions_or_Bills is a simulated count of transactions / bills.
Cafe Stock_Input_Units means prepared/production input of the finished menu item. For cafes, raw material consumption is derived from Units_Sold × Cafe_Recipe_BOM.
Grocery Stock_Input_Units means supplier deliveries of the SKU. Stock_Output_Units equals units sold plus waste/expired/damaged write-offs.
For each product-day: Opening_Stock + Stock_Input = Stock_Output + Closing_Stock. Waste is included in stock output and is separate from sold units.
Recipes and portion quantities are illustrative assumptions, not recipes observed from a real café. Confirm recipes, yield loss, packaging and prep yield before using operationally.
Next seven days use the average of up to four previous observations with the same weekday. Lower/upper values are indicative spread bands, not a validated prediction interval.

Material requirement forecast = product demand forecast × recipe quantities. Buy quantities cover supplier lead time + a 7-day review period + 2-day safety stock, minus on-hand and open PO quantity; order rounded to pack size / MOQ.
Grocery restock uses estimated demand from the same-weekday baseline and considers lead time, 2-day safety stock, on-hand, open POs, pack size and MOQ.

Recommendations are decision support only. They do NOT place orders. Human confirmation is needed for physical counts, approved suppliers, budget, shelf life, cold chain, pack sizes and delivery timing.
Expired batches are blocked from sale in the dataset logic. Near-expiry items are surfaced for supervisor review; never discount an expired or unsafe product.
Forecast_Backtest_* evaluates a simple same-weekday forecast on the last 14 days using synthetic estimated demand. It is not a real-world accuracy benchmark.
Unit contribution = sales revenue less item-level unit cost only. It excludes labour, rent, electricity, delivery, platform fees, taxes and other operating costs.
Label the workbook as a synthetic prototype. Do not claim observed customer demand, real revenue reduction, actual waste reduction or a completed customer pilot.
Replace illustrative inputs with the official C30 fixture and consented, anonymised store data; run the same workflow as a supervised pilot.
